title: Poojai
desc: A temple priest gives evidence in court about a murder that he has witnessed. Unfortunately for him, he bears witness against an influential landlord.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Alex Pandian
desc: Alex, a small-time thief, gets a contract to kidnap the chief minister's daughter, Divya, for three days. But when Divya reveals to him the real reason for her kidnap, he decides to help her.

title: Deepavali
desc: Billu and Susi are happily in love until he learns that she has forgotten him after being treated for post-traumatic stress disorder. He tries hard to make her remember about their relationship.

title: Surya: The Soldier
desc: An orphan raised by his deceased mother's friend, dreams of joining the army. Later, he must leave the love of his life behind when he receives his appointment letter.
